main_text.l: בסורתא, בסורא Ch. Nuncium, Praemium nuncii.
בסר, בסרא vel בשרא, בשרא Ch. & Syr. Caro.
בסרא, בוסרא Ch. Omphax, Uva acerba & immatura.
בסירא Ch. Spica mutica, Exod.9.31. in Jonath. Sed ibi
prave scriptum est per ד.
בסת בוסתנא, בוסתן Chal. Hortus. Plur. cum Affixo
לבוסתננא In hortos nostros, Esth.3.8. in T.sec. Vox
est in Targum inusitata, nec unquam, hoc loco ex-
cepto, occurrit. Talmudicis frequetior: Turcis au-
tem Arabibus & Persis usitata, a quibus videtur in
hanc linguam translata esse.
כמא Syr. Post, Pone, Retro. Cum לכמא, כמא
Retro, Retrorsum, Joh.18.6. כמא כמא A tergo,
Matth.9.20.
ביסתרקי Ch. Tapetes, Deuter.24.6. in Targ.Jonath.
בעא Ch.& Syr. Quaesivit, requisivit, petiit, postu-
lavit, oravit, obsecravit, rogavit, interroga-
vit: Item Exultare, idem cum בוע Jesa.35.1. sic cap.
24.14. Respondet etiam Pf.45.2. Hebraeo רחש Bul-
lire, ebullire, eructare. Ithpeh. אתבעי Quaeri, requiri,
Jerem.50.20.24. Vide praeterea בעא. Item Syr.
Requiri, requirere, Opus, Necessarium, necesse esse
vel habere. Partic. מתבעא Requisitum, necessa-
rium. Plur.foemin. מתבעא, 1. ad Corinth.12.21.
Hinc quidam explicat illud: אבעיא להון לממחי
נלותא Necesse est ipsis deleri captivitatem, Cantic.1.8. A-
lii, Qui (sc.Moses) postulabat ipsis deleri exilium. Aphel

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are printed in Hebrew and Syriac letters; several vocalised forms are approximated and marked for doubt where the scan is unclear. The final word "Aphel" is printed in italic at the right-hand edge.
